about: A report's file as the Reports tab's designer and Clarity's report tools read and write it (docs/ledger/reports-pdf.md, Agent tools for reports): `reports`, a file's text and the text written back (bands in the order they print, lengths in millimetres, words kept in their order); `parts`, what a new part of each kind starts with; `declarations`, a stylesheet with one declaration of a class set or taken out. crates/clarity-spec/src/report_design.rs reads these cases; the designer and Clarity's report tools both read and write reports through it.

reports.name: bands written in the order they print, words kept, entities read and written
reports.text:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!-- an invoice -->
<Report name="Invoice" paper="A4 landscape" margin="15mm" stylesheet="Invoice.css" headerFirst="false">
  <PageFooter height="8mm"><PageNumber at="80,0" size="10,5" align="center"/></PageFooter>
  <Data name="order" type="Order" />
  <Detail height="6" list="order.lines">
    <Field at="0,0" size="60,6" bind="line.product" class="cell"/>
    <Sum at="150.04,0" size="30,6" of="line.total" align="right"/>
  </Detail>
  <ReportHeader height="2cm">
    <Text at="0,0" size="120,10" key="invoiceTitle" class="title"/>
    <Text at="0,12" size="80,6" key="tom & "jerry""/>
  </ReportHeader>
  <GroupHeader height="7mm" by="line.category"/>
</Report>
reports.written:
<Report name="Invoice" paper="A4 landscape" margin="15mm" stylesheet="Invoice.css" headerFirst="false">
  <Data name="order" type="Order" />
  <ReportHeader height="20mm">
    <Text at="0,0" size="120,10" key="invoiceTitle" class="title" />
    <Text at="0,12" size="80,6" key="tom & "jerry"" />
  </ReportHeader>
  <GroupHeader height="7mm" by="line.category" />
  <Detail height="6mm" list="order.lines">
    <Field at="0,0" size="60,6" bind="line.product" class="cell" />
    <Sum at="150,0" size="30,6" of="line.total" align="right" />
  </Detail>
  <PageFooter height="8mm">
    <PageNumber at="80,0" size="10,5" align="center" />
  </PageFooter>
</Report>
